post.description:
Install the company's signing certificate from a PKCS#12 bundle, for one mode or both.

Needs ``signer.certificates.manage``. The certificate replaces, for each mode it serves, the company's
active one, which keeps the modes no new certificate took and is retired ``replaced`` once it serves
none. Refused 422 when the bundle cannot be opened with the password
(``certificate_bundle_unreadable``, whichever was wrong), holds no RSA key with its certificate
(``certificate_bundle_incomplete``), or its certificate cannot sign: a key under 2048 bits, no
digital signature usage, a CA, not valid now or for too short a time. The same key with another
bundle or other modes is ``idempotency_key_reused``. A test-mode request installs for test alone
(``certificate_modes_not_allowed``). Its outcome can be confirmed with ``GET /v1/certificates``, which
needs only ``signer.certificates.read``.

parameters.description: The modes it serves: test, live or both (repeated). By default the request's.
parameters.name: modes

schema.description: The modes it serves: test, live or both (repeated). By default the request's.
schema.title: Modes

parameters.description: The bundle's password, as base64 (standard alphabet, padded) of its UTF-8: it opens the bundle in the signer, and is never kept. Redact this header at every proxy, WAF and APM agent.
parameters.name: Ledger-Certificate-Password

schema.description: The bundle's password, as base64 (standard alphabet, padded) of its UTF-8: it opens the bundle in the signer, and is never kept. Redact this header at every proxy, WAF and APM agent.
schema.title: Ledger-Certificate-Password

parameters.description: test or live: the mode the request acts in.
parameters.name: Ledger-Mode

parameters.description: Makes a retry safe: the same key and body change state once and answer the same. A key is the caller's per organization, mode and operation, whatever the company it acts for: reused for another request (another company's too) it is refused (422 idempotency_key_reused).
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

schema.description: Makes a retry safe: the same key and body change state once and answer the same. A key is the caller's per organization, mode and operation, whatever the company it acts for: reused for another request (another company's too) it is refused (422 idempotency_key_reused).
schema.title: Idempotency-Key

parameters.description: The dated version of the API the request speaks (YYYY-MM-DD); its pin otherwise.
parameters.name: Ledger-Version

requestBody.description: A PKCS#12 bundle (.p12, .pfx): the signing certificate and its RSA key, 2 MiB.

Idempotent-Replayed.description: true when the answer is the one stored for an earlier use of the Idempotency-Key.

delete.description:
Retire a certificate of the request's mode for every mode: it never signs again.

Needs ``signer.certificates.manage``. One retired already is answered as it is. The company then has
no certificate in the modes it served until it installs another. A test-mode request never retires a
certificate that serves live: 409 ``certificate_serves_live``.
